Neumerkel GmbH is a German, family-owned company based in Kirchheim unter Teck that specializes in promotional merchandise and industrial contract printing. Karl Kuntze (GmbH & Co.), operating under the meterex brand, is a German manufacturer and supplier of measuring instruments and customized promotional products. Over its history, meterex developed from metal finishing and measuring-tape production into a specialist manufacturer of advertising-oriented measuring tools. Its product range includes folding rules, measuring tapes, spirit levels, rulers and other measuring instruments, which can be customized with company logos, graphics and advertising messages.

Marlin Mechanical Inc. is a New York City-based mechanical contracting and HVAC services company specializing in heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning systems for commercial and residential customers. Recovery Café is a U.S. nonprofit organization headquartered in Seattle, Washington, dedicated to providing long-term recovery support for people affected by trauma, homelessness, addiction, and mental-health challenges. The organization was founded in 2003 and opened its first physical café in Seattle in 2004. Its approach is based on the principle that sustained recovery requires not only treatment, but also stable relationships, community, belonging, and access to practical social services. Recovery Café provides a safe, drug- and alcohol-free environment where members can receive free meals, coffee, peer support, educational programs, referrals, and opportunities for personal development. Its core programs include Recovery Circles, which provide structured peer-to-peer support, and the School for Recovery, which offers classes addressing addiction, coping skills, mental health, and personal development. The organization also facilitates access to healthcare, housing assistance, employment resources, legal services, and substance-use treatment through partnerships with external providers. Recovery Café operates locations in Seattle and has developed the Recovery Café Network, which supports communities seeking to replicate its recovery-oriented model. The organization is funded primarily through charitable contributions, program revenue, and other nonprofit funding sources. Its work has made it a notable example of a community-based, recovery-oriented social-service model in the United States.

Palmetto Eye Institute is an independent ophthalmology practice located in Summerville, South Carolina, serving patients throughout the Berkeley, Dorchester, and surrounding counties. The practice was founded by Dr. Prat Itharat, a board-certified ophthalmologist who specializes in cataract surgery and comprehensive eye care. Dr. Itharat established the practice in 2012, after practicing in the South Carolina Lowcountry since 2008. The institute provides specialized eye-care services with a particular focus on cataract evaluation and surgery, including femtosecond laser-assisted cataract procedures and advanced intraocular lens options. Its broader clinical services include comprehensive ophthalmological examinations and diagnosis and management of common eye conditions. The practice emphasizes personalized care and describes itself as 100% independent and not owned by a private-equity organization, allowing physicians to tailor treatment and maintain a more personal relationship with patients.

McNish Steel Ltd. is a Canadian family-owned company specializing in the fabrication and installation of reinforcing steel (rebar) for the construction industry. The company is headquartered in Edmonton, Alberta, and was founded in 1978 by William and Wallace McNish. It has developed from a small family enterprise into an established regional rebar fabrication business serving contractors and construction projects across Western Canada. The company's services cover the complete reinforcing-steel process, including estimating, detailing, fabrication, delivery, and installation. Its product portfolio includes fabricated reinforcing bars, welded rebar cages, stud rails, anchor bolts, and concrete embeds. McNish Steel combines experienced personnel with specialized fabrication machinery and engineering software to manufacture reinforcing components according to project specifications and construction drawings.

HBPro – Informática e Serviços, Lda. is a Portuguese information-technology and telecommunications company headquartered in Amadora, in the Lisbon metropolitan area. Established in 1994, the company has more than three decades of experience providing technology products, infrastructure, consulting, maintenance, and technical support to business customers. Its principal registered activity is the retail trade of computers, peripheral equipment, and software, while its actual service portfolio extends considerably beyond conventional IT retail. HBPro provides IT infrastructure design, implementation, maintenance, outsourcing, networking, cybersecurity, cloud and hosting services, data recovery, disaster recovery, Microsoft 365 solutions, and printing services. The company also specializes in corporate telecommunications, including IP telephony, unified communications, contact-center technologies, telephone systems, and SIP solutions. Its services are intended to provide businesses with an integrated technology environment and ongoing technical support.

GSN Gestión y Administración de Fincas S.L. is a Spanish company specializing in property management and administration of residential and commercial real estate. Its website states that the organization has more than 20 years of experience in property advisory and administration, although the current legal entity was incorporated in December 2024. Its principal business activity is the professional management of homeowners' associations and properties. GSN Gestión provides a broad range of administrative, financial, and operational services for residential communities, shared-property developments, industrial estates, garages, and other managed properties. Services include preparation of annual budgets, calculation and collection of community fees, accounting, financial reporting, management of unpaid fees, preparation of meeting documentation and minutes, and representation before public authorities. The company also provides assistance with contracts, employee administration, insurance, maintenance, and supervision of building works.

Hijos de Francisco Gaya Fores S.L., operating under the Gayafores brand, is a Spanish manufacturer specializing in the production and commercialization of ceramic tiles and flooring and wall-covering products. The company is headquartered in Onda, Castellón, one of Europe's most important ceramic manufacturing regions. Established in 1949, Gayafores has more than seven decades of experience in the ceramic industry and has developed into an established manufacturer serving both domestic and international markets. The company's principal activity is the manufacture of ceramic tiles, including products designed for interior and exterior walls, floors, residential spaces, commercial buildings, hospitality projects, and architectural applications. Gayafores develops collections combining traditional ceramic manufacturing techniques with contemporary designs, formats, surface finishes, colors, and decorative concepts. The company's manufacturing facilities in Onda are registered as industrial ceramic production sites and include environmental and quality-management requirements; its production operations are certified according to ISO 9001:2015.

Century Maritime Agencies, Inc. (CENMAR) is a Philippine manning and crew-recruitment agency specializing in the recruitment, selection, training, and deployment of Filipino seafarers for international maritime employment. Its principal activity is supplying qualified Filipino crew members—including officers and ratings—to international shipowners and vessel operators. CENMAR's services cover the recruitment and screening of seafarers, verification of professional qualifications and certificates, medical fitness requirements, training coordination, and deployment of personnel according to the specific requirements of vessel owners and operators. The company maintains a pool of experienced maritime professionals and aims to provide appropriately qualified crew for different types of vessels and positions. Its operations are conducted within the regulatory framework governing overseas Filipino workers and maritime manning agencies in the Philippines.

KNOBEL Bau-Gruppe is a German family-owned construction company headquartered in Hartheim am Rhein, Baden-Württemberg. Founded in 1947, the company has grown from a small sand and gravel business established after the Second World War into one of the leading regional construction firms in the border region of Germany, France, and Switzerland. Today, the business is managed by the third generation of the Knobel family and has more than 75 years of experience in civil engineering and infrastructure development. The company is recognized for combining traditional craftsmanship with modern construction technologies and sustainable business practices. KNOBEL Bau-Gruppe provides a comprehensive portfolio of services, including road construction, civil engineering, sewer and drainage systems, earthworks, paving, road rehabilitation, demolition, asphalt milling, and environmental engineering. TRIWO Hahn Airport GmbH is the operator of Hahn Airport (HHN), an international commercial airport located in Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany. Originally developed as a United States military air base, the facility began civilian operations in 1993 and has since become one of Germany's most important regional airports. Hahn Airport operates 24 hours a day, making it one of the few German airports without night-flight restrictions, a significant advantage for cargo transportation and express logistics. The airport's business model is built on two major pillars: passenger aviation and air freight. In 2024, Hahn Airport handled approximately 1.87 million passengers and processed more than 105,000 tonnes of cargo, making it one of Germany's leading cargo airports. The airport serves over 30 international destinations, with Ryanair operating the majority of scheduled passenger flights. Its strategic location within the European economic corridor known as the "Blue Banana" provides direct access to major industrial and commercial markets across Germany, France, Belgium, Luxembourg, and the Netherlands.

Founded in 1976, the company has over 40 years of operational history and has built a reputation for supplying high-quality metallic hydraulic tubing assemblies, custom powder coating services and engineered fabrication solutions to sectors such as construction equipment, agricultural machinery, mining vehicles and stationary industrial equipment. Tru-Line’s products contribute to the performance and longevity of heavy-duty machinery used in essential infrastructure, food production, transportation and resource extraction.

With almost 40 years of experience in the drywall industry, the firm focuses on light-gauge metal framing, standard metal stud framing, insulation, drywall installation and related finishing work for new builds and renovations. The company prides itself on high standards of workmanship, personalised service, experienced site supervision and a strong commitment to safety, including dedicated safety personnel and third-party inspection for job sites.

LC Publishing Group LC Publishing Group S.p.A. is an international digital publishing and information services company headquartered in Milan, Italy. Founded in 2011, the group focuses on producing 100% digital information and news content in specialised professional markets, particularly legal, tax, finance and food sectors from a business-oriented perspective. Its portfolio includes a network of digital titles such as Legalcommunity.it, Financecommunity.it, Inhousecommunity.it and Foodcommunity.it, along with English-language sites such as Legalcommunity.ch, portals oriented to Middle East and North Africa and Latin American legal publications like Iberian Lawyer and The Latin American Lawyer. The group also organises industry events, awards, conferences and workshops across countries including Brazil, Mexico, Spain, Portugal, Egypt, Switzerland and Italy, supporting professional networking and thought leadership within its core fields.

Interr Interr is a privately held security and risk-management services company headquartered at The Loom, 14 Gower’s Walk, London, UK. Established in 1998, the firm provides a wide range of protective and operational support services to businesses across the retail, hospitality, residential, corporate and event sectors in the United Kingdom, Europe and Asia. Interr’s core offerings include intelligent guarding, security officers, remote monitoring and response, reception and front-of-house staff, crisis management, investigations, security consultancy, safety training, and event security solutions tailored to complex organisational needs. The company also supports clients with bespoke compliance training, risk assessments and incident handling designed to enhance workplace safety, regulatory compliance and on-site resilience.

GS Global Resources GS Global Resources (often abbreviated GSGR) is an American industrial engineering and machine-performance solutions company headquartered in Mukwonago, Wisconsin. Founded in 1972, the firm has grown from a component distributor into a technical partner for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) that operate in heavy-industry and mobile-equipment markets. GSGR’s expertise spans hydraulic systems, electronic controls, mechanical integration and software applications, allowing it to design, engineer and deliver advanced integrated solutions that enhance the performance, control and reliability of machinery used in sectors such as agriculture, construction, mining, forestry and industrial automation. The company’s offerings include custom hydraulic assemblies, operator cab solutions, control systems, sensor integration, remote monitoring, valve and power units, and bespoke engineering to address complex machine-design challenges.

Administración de Infraestructuras Ferroviarias Sociedad del Estado ADIFSE — formally the Administración de Infraestructuras Ferroviarias Sociedad del Estado — is a state-owned railway infrastructure company in Argentina responsible for the planning, execution and control of maintenance, improvements and renewal of the national railroad infrastructure. It operates under the umbrella of Trenes Argentinos Infraestructura, a division of the national Ferrocarriles Argentinos holding that oversees construction and upkeep of rail lines, signaling systems and related civil works across the country. ADIFSE’s core mission is to ensure that Argentina’s rail infrastructure supports safe, efficient and continuous passenger and freight operations on the nation’s expansive rail network.

RLC Transportes RLC Transportes (operating under Rau Load Cargo, S.L.) is a Spanish logistics and freight-transport company based in El Puig de Santa Maria, Valencia. Founded in 1993, the company initially specialised in transporting fruits and vegetables but has since expanded into the import and export of all types of goods, with a notable focus on refrigerated transport for temperature-sensitive cargo such as food products. RLC has grown into one of Spain’s most experienced transport agencies, operating a modern fleet of over 300 trucks and maintaining multiple delegations across Spain and Italy (e.g., Valencia, Barcelona, Seville, Bologna), alongside a professional team of more than 100 logistics operators and multilingual traffic coordinators.
